title: 鉄筋コンクリート工学
subtitle: Reinforced Concrete Engineering
teachers:
HANAOKA Daishin
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Understand the principles and features of reinforced concrete.
(2) Master the basic theory of behavior of reinforced concrete subjected to bending and shearing.
(3) Understand the design method of reinforced concrete and the principle and characteristics of prestressed concrete.
advice:
This is a basic course on construction materials. We will cover the following topics:

1. Principles and features of reinforced concrete, properties of constituent materials, conditions and structural
details for reinforced concrete.
2. Behavior of reinforced concrete beams subjected to bending
3. Behavior of reinforced concrete beams subjected to shear
4. Design methods for reinforced concrete
5. Principles and features of prestressed concrete

Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class.

This is useful preparation for lectures on Disaster Prevention Engineering and Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a basic course on construction materials. We will cover the following topics:

1. Principles and features of reinforced concrete, properties of constituent materials, conditions and structural
details for reinforced concrete.
2. Behavior of reinforced concrete beams subjected to bending
3. Behavior of reinforced concrete beams subjected to shear
4. Design methods for reinforced concrete
5. Principles and features of prestressed concrete

Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class.

This is useful preparation for lectures on Disaster Prevention Engineering and Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises.
